newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FNB joins forces with development agency.
newsitem.headline: FNB joins forces with development agency.

text.p: First National Bank Holdings Ltd on Tuesday announced that it had joined forces with community services and development consultancy Billy Hattingh & Associates (BH&A).

The bank said in a statement the long-term strategic alliance with BH&A was aimed at the development of entrepreneurs and communities and the steady growth of the Small Medium and Micro Enterprises sector in South Africa.

First National Bank senior manager for local government business Philip van den Heever said the bank would not only finance equipment required by entrepreneurs but also offer them a full range of products from across the FNB group.
"FNB intends to be a strategic partner, playing an active role in marketing BH&A's business concept and assisting the entrepreneurs...with guidance and education," van den Heever said.
